operations.description: Executable schema-gated Bahmni patient search: connector-authored flags map to an allow-listed JSON body, the response is bounded, and no raw request body or generic HTTP flag is exposed.
operations.approval: none: read-only POST query with schema-gated body and bounded JSON output; clinical PHI fields are not generally field-redacted by the current engine

q.description: Free-text patient name or identifier search term.

addressFieldName.description: Address field to filter on, e.g. city_village.

loginLocationUuid.description: Login/deployment location UUID scoping the search.

startIndex.description: Zero-based result offset for bounded paging.
